subject.title: fix: deliver sessions_yield message on empty-payload turns

question: Should `sessions_yield` permanently gain a separate user-visible `acknowledgment` parameter while retaining `message` as hidden continuation context?
rationale: The underlying silence is real, but adding a new model-facing tool field rather than changing the existing field’s visibility establishes a permanent contract that source inspection alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Add explicit acknowledgment
options.body: Keep `message` hidden and implement `acknowledgment` consistently across embedded, Codex, Copilot, and the shared reply path.

options.title: Expose existing message
options.body: Make `message` user-visible on eligible empty turns, accepting a semantic change to the shipped hidden-context field.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Pause both candidate PRs until the sessions-yield visibility API is designed and approved.

recommendation.title: Add explicit acknowledgment
recommendation.body: Keep `message` hidden and implement `acknowledgment` consistently across embedded, Codex, Copilot, and the shared reply path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal is the commit that introduced the sessions-yield lifecycle and its hidden continuation behavior.
